summary: Tuniu Corp disclosed via Form 6-K a cash dividend of US$1.197 per ADS, totaling approximately US$13 million, to holders of record as of May 4, 2026, payable on or about May 20, 2026. The dividend was previously declared on March 20, 2026, but per-ADS disclosure was delayed pending an ADS ratio change from 1:3 to 1:30, effective April 22, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The payment will be made through the depositary bank under the deposit agreement. This is a capital return event with no tender or structural complexity beyond the ratio change. Watch for timely execution of the dividend payment.
